# Badge get capture

Captured 2026-11-09 with an unauthenticated request (no credential, no cookie)
to `GET https://badges.roblox.com/v1/badges/{badgeId}` for an enabled badge of a
large public universe. `get-response.json` is the sanitized full successful
body. Badge, icon, universe and root place IDs, badge names and descriptions,
and the universe name are replaced with stable fakes. Field shapes, types,
timestamps and statistics are kept. No request headers are stored.

The response carried `x-ratelimit-limit: 600, 600;w=60`.
